How are you backing up a home server in 2026?

I have been running the same backup arrangement for about eight years and I have finally admitted that I do not understand what it protects me from. It is a nightly rsync of everything under one directory to an external disk, plus a second copy to a machine at a relative's house, and both have run without complaint for long enough that I stopped reading the logs.

The case against the monorepo, eight years in

We moved everything into one repository in 2018 for the reasons everyone gives, and most of them turned out to be true. What nobody told us is which costs arrive later, and they all arrive at once, roughly when the build stops fitting on a developer's machine.
